text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping, I turned 
around to a voice ringing high into the 
sky—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It is calling me... The hot spring, right 
now, calls to me! —Yes, with a 'Welcome!'"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Listen! You can hear it too, can't you, 
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reflexively replied, but what in the 
world was she talking about?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems she wants to draw that 
lottery. I just finished shopping and got 
a ticket myself. In this situation—
choice_data_list: It's only one, but here you go.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as expected! Alright, I'm all 
set! Here we go...! Let's... Fukubiki Go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if putting her own luck to the test, 
Seeking the Pearl fixed her gaze upon the 
raffle with an earnest expression.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It will be the future that crowns our 
hot, big dream! C'mon, hot springs 
trip—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl gave the lottery wheel's 
handle an eager spin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!! Yet again! I have demonstrated 
the boundless potential of Seeking the 
Pearl!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Things are going to get busier than ever 
now. I need to check the spring water 
quality and look into gorgeous dinner 
options!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, don't you think understanding the 
ingredients makes the flavors of the dish 
even deeper?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that you understand, start 
getting things prepared right away, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what's the matter? You're coming 
too, you know. To the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, well of course, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes for me to show the 
world new possibilities and make a 
worldwide splash, I'll polish myself up 
even further at the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, you'll have to be 
thoroughly polished as well, won't you? 
Since you'll be standing right beside 
me!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was coming along... 
No, in Seeking the Pearl's mind, it seems 
it was decided from the very beginning 
that we'd go together.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll have it ready.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, let us shine fabulously!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Just you wait! In the near 
future, I, Seeking the Pearl, shall make 
the entire world shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl proudly holds up the hot 
springs ticket she received.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep working hard so that I can 
reach the wish entrusted within it...!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's a corporate trap.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So you want me, Seeking the Pearl, with my 
truly excellent palate, to do a tasting 
for your hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taking the roundabout approach... How 
adorable.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If I utter a single "Delicious," 
it's practically recognized worldwide!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Let us partake, with no holding 
back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, let's get cooking! High-class 
carrots and meat fit for someone like me! 
Failure is not an option!! Let's do this!"
choice_data_list: You want me to grill it!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did my sudden dinner invitation catch 
you off guard? There's no need to hold 
back, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Borrowing the academy's kitchen, I enjoyed 
a premium carrot hamburg steak with a 
boisterously laughing Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's almost as if it's showing us 
the FUTURE!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just look at this mountain of carrots... I 
can already hear the cheers rising up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is... the sight of countless 
fans gazing dazzled upon me!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel fantastic! Come on, Trainer! Let's 
invite all of our fans to my house!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Today's a feast! Allow me to whip 
up some delicious cooking for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's the academy, not my house... They 
look like fans, but they're cooking... I 
decided against pointing out any of that."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hum hum hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing the delighted look on Seeking 
the Pearl's face made the lottery feel as 
rewarding as winning the grand prize... or 
so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a troublesome carrot. Did you 
really want to come to me that badly?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I can't let you regret 
choosing me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Glacé! Let's make this the sweetest thing 
in the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll give half to you too, Trainer! Try to 
keep up with me! Ho-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I frantically chased after Seeking the 
Pearl as she bolted off with a carrot in 
one hand.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, tissues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I tried to think of some comforting 
words wondering if she might be feeling 
down—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Made in America! Now I get it! It was pure 
destiny that it found its way to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I shall gladly take it home with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl happily tucked the pack 
of tissues into her pocket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I kept to myself the fact that it 
wasn't 'Made in America,' but merely 
featured a popular American character.
